paragraphs: Rabbah bar Mari. In the West, in Rava bar Mari's name: Zevahim 90b; Horayot 13a; Helek 100a. R’ Yitzhak reported a Western teaching in the name of Rava bar Mari. The checked witness reads Rabbah bar Mari (Yoma 86b). He reported teachings of R’ Yehoshua ben Levi (Berakhot 42b and 44a). See also the alternate transmissions at Sukkah 32b. Yoma 78a (Yom Ha-Kippurim) reports that R’ Yehoshua ben Levi used a cloth. When Rabbah bar Mari came, he gave a parallel account. R' Maryon said that R' Yehoshua ben Levi said; some say, Rabbah bar Mari taught in Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai's name: Sukkah 32b. Rava bar Mari expounded: Eruvin 86a. Rava spoke to him: Mo'ed Katan 28b; Yevamot 63b. He visited Rava's house: Berakhot 42b. Rava asked him, ‘Whence is this matter?’ etc., many matters: end of Ha-Hovel. Rabbah asked Rava bar Mari, “What is the source for this?” (Yevamot 62b). Heilprin suggests reading “Rava asked him.”
